title: My Wallet Is Missing
synopsis: After watching a movie, Anne discovers that her wallet is missing. She goes back to the theater to try and find it and speaks with the box office attendant.

fullText.simplified:
我的钱包不见了

Anne：您好。我的钱包不见了，我可以进去找一下吗？
Attendant：您的钱包是什么颜色的？我们阿姨在打扫影院时发现了一个钱包。
Anne：太好了！我的钱包是白色的，有点儿旧。
Attendant：您还记得您的钱包里有什么吗？
Anne：里面有我的护照和信用卡，还有一些钱。
Attendant：请问护照是哪个国家的？信用卡是哪个银行的？
Anne：护照是美国的，信用卡是中国银行的。
Attendant：国家是对的，信用卡也对了。请问您的名字是什么？
Anne：我叫Anne。
Attendant：名字也对了。那再请问一下，您还记得钱包里一共有多少钱吗？
Anne：钱包里有两张一百元，一张五十元和三张十元，一共是两百八十元。
Attendant：没错，都对了。这是您的钱包，请拿好。
Anne：谢谢！你们太好了！
Attendant：请再检查一下钱包里的东西。我们阿姨是在打扫椅子时发现这个钱包的。
Anne：护照，信用卡，钱……都对！谢谢你们阿姨！她真是个好人！
Attendant：不客气！欢迎您再来我们影院看电影。
fullText.traditional:
我的錢包不見了

Anne：您好。我的錢包不見了，我可以進去找一下嗎？
Attendant：您的錢包是什麼顏色的？我們阿姨在打掃影院時發現了一個錢包。
Anne：太好了！我的錢包是白色的，有點兒舊。
Attendant：您還記得您的錢包裡有什麼嗎？
Anne：裡面有我的護照和信用卡，還有一些錢。
Attendant：請問護照是哪個國家的？信用卡是哪個銀行的？
Anne：護照是美國的，信用卡是中國銀行的。
Attendant：國家是對的，信用卡也對了。請問您的名字是什麼？
Anne：我叫Anne。
Attendant：名字也對了。那再請問一下，您還記得錢包裡一共有多少錢嗎？
Anne：錢包裡有兩張一百元，一張五十元和三張十元，一共是兩百八十元。
Attendant：沒錯，都對了。這是您的錢包，請拿好。
Anne：謝謝！你們太好了！
Attendant：請再檢查一下錢包裡的東西。我們阿姨是在打掃椅子時發現這個錢包的。
Anne：護照，信用卡，錢……都對！謝謝你們阿姨！她真是個好人！
Attendant：不客氣！歡迎您再來我們影院看電影。

sentence_translations: Anne: Hello. My wallet is missing. Can I go in and look for it?
Attendant: What color is your wallet? Our cleaning lady found a wallet while cleaning the movie theater.
Anne: Great! My wallet is white and a bit old.
Attendant: Do you remember what was in your wallet?
Anne: There was my passport and credit card, and also some cash in it.
Attendant: May I ask which country your passport is from? Which bank is your credit card from?
Anne: The passport is from the United States, and the credit card is from the Bank of China.
Attendant: The country is correct, and the credit card is also correct. May I ask what your name is?
Attendant: The name is also correct. Then, may I also ask, do you remember how much money was in your wallet in total?
Anne: There were two one hundred yuan bills, one fifty yuan bill, and three ten yuan bills in my wallet, totaling two hundred eighty yuan.
Attendant: That’s right, everything is correct. Here is your wallet, please keep it safe.
Anne: Thank you! You’ve been too kind!
Attendant: Please check the contents of the wallet again. Our cleaning lady found this wallet while cleaning the seats.
Anne: Passport, credit card, money … all present and correct! Thank you to your cleaning lady! She is really a good person!
Attendant: Don’t mention it! You’re welcome to come back to our theater to watch another movie.
